# XIVKit

> XIVKit is a curated, unofficial list of Final Fantasy XIV (FFXIV) tools and Dalamud plugins that the maintainer actually uses, plus original guides hosted on the site. Every entry is hand-picked and annotated with why it's useful, rather than an exhaustive directory.

The site is static and every page is plain HTML. Market board prices on the guides are fetched live from Universalis. FINAL FANTASY XIV is a registered trademark of Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. XIVKit is fan-made and not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix.

## Guides

- [Jump Puzzle Macros](https://xivkit.com/jump-puzzle-macros.html): Timed macro-and-hotbar technique for jumping exact, repeatable distances in FFXIV jumping puzzles, with copyable macros and a calibration spot.
- [Hunt for Astronomy: What's Worth the Tomes](https://xivkit.com/hunt-for-astronomy.html): Every reward in the Hunt for Astronomy trove, its alternate sources, market board prices, and a verdict on whether it's worth the tomestones.
- [Trade-In Mounts: Grind vs. Buy the Mats](https://xivkit.com/trade-in-mounts.html): Every FFXIV mount unlocked by trading in items or currency, with live market board prices and a verdict on grinding versus buying.
- [Inventory & Retainer Decluttering](https://xivkit.com/inventory-decluttering.html): A keep, bank, or discard decision tree for a full bag or retainer, with storage tips, ways to sell or desynthesize, and the short list of items that never come back once discarded.
- [Retainer Ventures: What to Send Them For](https://xivkit.com/retainer-ventures.html): Ranks every retainer venture by what it earns on the market board for your retainer's class, level, and stats, with live prices and sales speed.
- [Keybound Brawler: The Grind Math](https://xivkit.com/keybound-brawler.html): What every Keybound Brawler reward costs in MGC, how many runs it takes to afford them all, and how long the Magitype Magister title grind is.
- [Fan Fest Keynote Bingo Maker](https://xivkit.com/fanfest-bingo.html): Build, randomize, play and export an FFXIV Fan Fest keynote bingo card as a shareable PNG, with suggested predictions and community jokes.
- [MSQ Tracker with a Shareable Link](https://xivkit.com/msq-tracker.html): Track Main Scenario Quest progress through the latest patch, with the current quest in the page link for easy sharing and a PNG progress card to export.

## Lists

- [Tools & Links](https://xivkit.com/): Curated FFXIV tools grouped by use: market and economy, progress trackers, glamour, housing, reference databases, and community sites.
- [Plugins](https://xivkit.com/plugins.html): Dalamud plugins in active use, tagged by whether they're in the default plugin directory or need a custom (experimental) repo.
- [Plugin directory](https://xivkit.com/plugins/): Browsable directory of Dalamud plugins, official and from well-known third-party repositories (marked with a badge), by category with install counts, install status and how-to-install steps. Generated from the live plugin lists.

## Plugin directory categories

- [Housing](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/housing/): Plugins for decorating, placing and managing houses, apartments and your Free Company estate.
- [Roleplay and venues](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/roleplay/): Character profiles, custom titles, RP event calendars, and tools for running or visiting player venues.
- [Minigames and fun](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/games/): Games to play while you wait or lie dead on the floor, plus dice, cards and other silly extras.
- [Glamour and mods](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/glamour/): Outfit, plate and appearance tools, camera and screenshot helpers, and tools for mod loaders and posing.
- [Market and economy](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/market/): Market board price checks, retainer helpers, and tools for selling and crafting for profit.
- [Crafting and gathering](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/crafting-gathering/): Crafting macros and solvers, gathering routes and node timers, fishing helpers, and Island Sanctuary planners.
- [Combat and duties](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/combat/): Job gauges, cooldown trackers, mechanic helpers, fly text, and tools for dungeons, roulettes, hunts and other duty content.
- [UI and HUD](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/ui/): Replacements and tweaks for the HUD, hotbars, bars, windows, nameplates, tooltips and menus.
- [Chat and social](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/chat-social/): Chat windows and filters, friend lists, linkshells, translation, and tools for staying in touch.
- [Audio and music](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/audio-music/): Orchestrion, bard and music helpers, plus sound and volume controls.
- [Graphics and performance](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/graphics/): Frame rate, resolution, shadow and render settings, crash and input fixes, and other tweaks to the game client itself.
- [Quality of life](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/quality-of-life/): Small helpers that remove friction: tweaks, reminders, collection trackers, notifications and shortcuts.
- [Other](https://xivkit.com/plugins/category/other/): Everything that does not fit a bigger bucket: odd, useful and one-of-a-kind plugins.

## Optional

- [Watchlist](https://xivkit.com/watchlist.html): FFXIV tools that are recommended but not yet tried by the maintainer.
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/malobear/xivkit): The site's source, open to pull requests.
